lines.say: Will a late workout ruin your sleep?
Most people think so. The research says, mostly no.
A big review looked at studies of evening exercise.
Overall, people slept just as well, and some slept a bit deeper.
The exception: very hard sessions that ended less than an hour before bed.
Those could make it take longer to fall asleep.
Your body needs time to cool down and calm your heart rate.
So finish hard training at least an hour before bed. And watch the pre-workout caffeine.
Next time: why does your heart keep racing after you stop?
